title: PostgreSQL foreign key and JSON conversions bypass EXECUTE privilege on cast functions (CVE-2026-116303)
description: A missing authorization check in PostgreSQL type conversion allows users to invoke cast functions without EXECUTE privilege via foreign keys and JSON conversion functions like to_json(). This issue affects versions prior to PostgreSQL 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7. Exploitation requires identifying access-restricted cast functions and the confidentiality impact varies by function implementation. There are few practical examples of such functions or confidentiality impacts.
